fields.subject: ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable
fields.condition: the cluster membership query contract is invoked with a request to initialize its version record
fields.trigger: the caller sets tryInitTableVersion to true
fields.response: submit the cluster identifier with ETag number 0 and version 0 to create the initial version record
fields.postcondition: the initialization task represents that query execution; when the caller sets tryInitTableVersion to false, the task completes without submitting an initialization query
